Source: Faith and Fire, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference-st.JournalEntry.yEPxZHRgMGIQ2JJQ]{Derangements}

Perfectionists seek to control every aspect of their unlives, often following a set of rules intended to ensure that everything "runs to plan." All their efforts are directed to ensuring that things happen as intended.

Trigger/Effect: If things don't go as planned, the perfectionist becomes agitated, possibly even entering frenzy.
